g.text: not most ransomware brands or darknet markets
152 named criminal enterprises: how those that have closed came to an end, % of each sector
Ended by police: takedowns, seizures, arrests, sanctions or quitting under police pressure. *Carding shops, DDoS-for-hire, phishing
kits, bulletproof hosting, scam compounds. Shares flatter the police: documented enterprises are more often ones they caught.
Sources: US Department of Justice; Europol and Operation Endgame partners; Britain's National Crime Agency; US Treasury;
Microsoft; MITRE; Chainalysis; Krebs on Security; Wikipedia; ransomware.live; Gwern Branwen; court records and press reports;
